strings.meta.title: pdff — PDF, Word, Excel kaɗo, juyawa da gyarawa kyauta
strings.meta.description: Kayan aiki na kyauta ta intanet don haɗawa, jujjuya, matse, raba da kariya ga fayilolinku na PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint da hotuna. Ba buƙatar rajista ba, ana goge fayiloli nan take.

strings.footer.text: Kyauta, babu rajista. Ana gogewa fayilolinku da zaran an gama aiki.

strings.home.steps[1].text: Sanya tsari, tsarin fitarwa ko shafukan da za a riƙe.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% kyauta
strings.seo.why[0].text: Babu biyan kuɗi, babu katin banki, babu tambarin ruwa da aka ƙara a kan takardunku.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Babu rajista
strings.seo.why[1].text: Babu asusun da za a buɗe: buɗe shafin, jefa fayilolinku, an gama.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Fayilolinku naku ne kaɗai
strings.seo.why[2].text: An sarrafa su, sannan an goge su nan take. Ba mu riƙe takardunku ko bayananku ba.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Kowane tsari
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, hotuna, EPUB… daga kwamfuta ko waya.
strings.seo.faqTitle: Tambayoyin da aka fi yawan yi
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Eh. Kowane kayan aiki kyauta ne, babu tambarin ruwa kuma babu abin da ke kulle a bayan biyan kuɗi. Ba a taɓa buƙatar katin banki ba.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: A'a. Babu rajista, babu adireshin imel: zaka yi amfani da kayan aikin nan take.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: A'a. Ana amfani da fayilolinku ne kawai don aikin da kuka nema, sannan a goge su. Babu wanda ke karanta su kuma ba a taɓa raba su ba.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: Shin yana aiki a kan waya?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Eh. pdff yana aiki a cikin burusa na kowace waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ba tare da an sanya komai ba.
strings.seo.faq[4].q: Wadanne tsari ne ake goyon bayansu?
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, hotuna (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML da sauransu.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Zaka iya sarrafa har zuwa fayiloli {files} a lokaci guda, kuma takardar da aka fitar tana iya samun har zuwa shafuka {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Sirri
strings.privacy.description: Yadda pdff ke kula da fayilolinku: babu asusu, babu takardar da aka riƙe, babu talla kuma babu siyar da bayanai.
strings.privacy.intro: An gina pdff ne ta yadda takardunku za su kasance naku. Ga abin da ke faruwa lokacin da kuka yi amfani da shi, a cikin sauƙaƙan kalmomi.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Fayilolinku
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ana aika su a ɓoye (HTTPS), an sarrafa su ta atomatik, sannan an goge su da zaran sakamakon ya shirya. Manyan fayiloli suna bi ta wurin ajiyewa na ɗan lokaci a ƙarƙashin suna mai sauƙi kuma ana share su da zaran an gama aiki; tsarin sharewa ta atomatik yana cire duk abin da ya rage a cikin sa'o'i 24 a mafi yawancin lokaci.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Babu asusu, babu bayanan sirri
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ba ya buƙatar rajista, adireshin imel da katin banki. Ba a taɓa karanta takardunku, nazari, raba su ko amfani da su wajen horar da hankali na wucin gadi ba.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Auna masu ziyara
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Muna ƙidaya ziyara ba tare da bayyana suna ba kuma ba tare da kukis ba (Vercel Web Analytics) don sanin waɗanne kayan aiki ne ke da amfani. Babu talla, babu bin diddigin tsakanin shafuka.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kukis
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki guda ɗaya na zaɓi: yana tuna harshen da kuka zaɓa.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Saukarda shafin
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel ne ke karɓ ba baƙi a kan sabar a Paris; Render ne ke sarrafa juyawar Word, Excel da PowerPoint a Frankfurt. Waɗannan masu ba da sabar suna kula da fayiloli ne kawai tsawon lokacin juyawa.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Tuntuɓe
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Tambaya ko sharhi? Tuntuɓe mu daga shafin aikin:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Haɗa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Haɗa fayiloli da yawa (PDF, Word, hotuna…) zuwa PDF guda ɗaya, a tsarin da kuka zaɓa.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Haɗa fayilolin PDF ta intanet kyauta (Word, hotuna, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Haɗa PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint da hotuna zuwa PDF guda ɗaya, a tsarin da kuke so. Kyauta, babu rajista, babu tambarin ruwa, an goge fayiloli nan take.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Sanya takardunku duka a fayil guda ɗaya: pdff yana karɓar PDF da takardun Word, jadawalin Excel, gabatarwa da hotuna, kuma yana haɗa su zuwa PDF guda mai tsabta tare da alamomi a kowane fayil.

strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Jujjuya kowace takarda ko hoto zuwa wani tsari.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Jujjuya PDF zuwa Word, Word zuwa PDF, JPG zuwa PDF — kyauta
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Mai jujjuya kyauta: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB da tsari 40+. Kan intanet, babu rajista, inganci mai yawa.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Mai jujjuya guda don kowane tsari: Word zuwa PDF, PDF zuwa Word, JPG zuwa PDF, PDF zuwa JPG, Excel zuwa PDF, PowerPoint zuwa PDF, PNG zuwa JPG, EPUB zuwa PDF… Jefa fayilolinku kuma pdff yana ba da tsarin da zai yiwu kawai.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Raba PDF zuwa fayiloli da yawa: ta kewayon shafuka ko shafi bayan shafi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Raba PDF ta intanet kyauta — raba shafuka
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Raba PDF zuwa fayiloli da yawa: ta kewayon shafuka, shafi bayan shafi ko kowane shafuka N. Kyauta, da sauri kuma babu rajista.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Aika sashin da ya fi muhimmanci na babban takarda kaɗai: pdff yana yanke PDF ɗinku gwargwadon kewayon da kuka zaɓa kuma yana dawo da sassan a cikin fayilolin ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Cire ko goge shafuka daga PDF — kyauta
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Riƙe shafukan da kuke buƙata kawai daga PDF, ko cire waɗanda suka wuce. Kan intanet, kyauta, babu rajista, babu tambarin ruwa.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Shafi mara komai, ƙarin bayani mara amfani, kwafi biyu? Rubuta shafukan da za a riƙe ko cire (misali 1-3, 7, 10-end) kuma sami PDF mai tsabta a cikin daƙiƙa.

strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Canza tsarin shafi, kwafi, juya baya.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Sake tsara shafukan PDF ta intanet — kyauta
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Canza tsarin shafukan PDF, kwafi wasu ko juya dukkan takardar. Kyauta, kan intanet, babu rajista.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: An duba shafuka ba a tsari ba? Rubuta sabon tsari (misali 3, 1, 2, 4-end) ko juya dukkan takardar: pdff zai yi sauran.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Juya dukkan shafukan PDF ko wasu kaɗai, da 90°, 180° ko 270°. Kyauta, da sauri, babu rajista.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Binciken da ke sama ƙasa ko shafin kwance? Juya dukkan takardar ko shafukan da kuka zaɓa kaɗai, ba tare da asarar inganci ba.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Ƙara lambobin shafuka zuwa PDF: zaɓi wuri, tsarin "1 / 10", lambar farko da girman rubutu. Kyauta, babu rajista.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Cikakke ga kasida, takardar neman aiki ko rahoto: zaɓi wuri, tsari da lambar farko, kuma pdff zai sanya lambobi a shafukanku da kyau.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Matse PDF ta intanet — rage girman fayil kyauta
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Rage girman PDF don aika shi ta imel ko ɗora shi a shafin yanar gizo na hukuma. Matakan matsewa guda uku, kyauta.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Wani shafin yanar gizo ya ƙi karɓar fayil ɗinku saboda yana da nauyi sosai? Matse PDF ɗinku yayin kiyaye rubutu mai kaifi: zaɓi maras asara, abin da aka ba da shawarar ko mai ƙarfi dangane da girman da kuke buƙata.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Kulle PDF tare da kalmar sirri (AES-256) kuma hana bugawa, kwafi ko gyarawa. Kyauta, babu rajista.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Kafin aika takardar albashi ko takardar likita, kulle shi da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi: ba tare da ita ba, babu wanda zai iya buɗe shi.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Cire kalmar sirri daga PDF wanda kuka san kalmar sirrinsa, don buɗewa, bugawa ko haɗa shi kyauta. Kyauta.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Kun san kalmar sirri, amma buga ta kowane lokaci matsala ce? Cire ta sau ɗaya da har abada. pdff ba ya taɓa ketare kalmar sirri da ba ku sani ba.
